vte_events.poolable_reason: k=1, AND THE SECOND TRIAL BELONGS TO A DIFFERENT DRUG. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18. NCT01857583 tests DU-176b (edoxaban) at three doses, ALL typed EXPERIMENTAL, against fondaparinux as its ACTIVE_COMPARATOR -- so it is an edoxaban trial and fondaparinux appears in it only as the control. That is the OLMESARTAN shape and it is real here for that one trial. NCT00789399 IS a genuine fondaparinux trial: its own title reads 'A Study of the Efficacy of Preventive Dosing of Fondaparinux Sodium Versus Placebo' and its other arm is typed PLACEBO_COMPARATOR, so fondaparinux is unambiguously the tested agent even though its arm is typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR. SO THIS TOPIC IS NOT COMPARATOR-SHAPED -- it does contain a fondaparinux trial -- but it contains exactly one, and a single trial is reported as a single trial.

vte_events.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that the contributing trial is poor -- it is registered, randomised and reports its primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that this page holds one trial that answers the question its title asks.
vte_events.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
vte_events.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
vte_events.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In Fondaparinux in venous thromboembolism, what is the effect on Venous thromboembolism and major bleeding events?

It examines 1 randomised trial and DOES NOT POOL THEM.

The outcome sought is Venous thromboembolism and major bleeding events.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.

bookkeeping_2026_08_21._what: The five reporting claims a PRISMA-2020 manuscript needs that are FETCHABLE rather than argued -- each derived from a field here, or stated as an honest absence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_limbs_this_review_refuses: Of the four properties this project requires of a completed topic, 0 are held (none) and 4 are refused with the obstacle named in the evidence (comparison denominator, grade per pool, model output verbatim, rob per result).
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.the_search_its_date_and_its_databases: PRIMARY TRIALS. NO BIBLIOGRAPHIC SEARCH FOR PRIMARY TRIALS WAS RUN. The 2 included trials were identified by reading named registrations on 2026-08-18. Every registration read in full on 2026-08-18, including armsInterventionsModule.armGroups[].type and interventionNames[], and the brief title. Arm TYPE alone was not sufficient on either topic and the reading says why.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.whether_this_review_was_prospectively_re: NO PROSPERO REGISTRATION OR PROTOCOL RECORD IS HELD ON THIS OBJECT. That is not the same as knowing this review was not registered, and neither claim is made. It is recorded here as an absence so that a reader does not have to infer it from silence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.that_two_assessors_disagreed_and_where: NO SECOND, INDEPENDENT RISK-OF-BIAS ASSESSMENT IS RECORDED FOR THIS TOPIC. The judgements were made once. Stated so that single assessment is not mistaken for agreement between two.
